_comment: Copy to %APPDATA%\M365Tools\hr_feed.json and fill in — or just open the HR Tasks section, the setup card writes this for you. Never commit the filled-in file. 'columns' and 'form_map' are optional per feed (sensible defaults apply); 'org_codes' maps the org names HR writes in 'Account Required' (e.g. 'Email - Reach') to tenant keys from config.json.
